en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a traditional Swedish clergy house (prästgård) surrounded by trees and a white picket fence. The building, Holms prästgård, is centered in the image with a flagpole and several coniferous trees around it. The reverse side shows handwritten Swedish text, a postmark dated 1913, and addresses including the recipient's name and the place name 'Alaudberg'. There is also a printed indication of postage rates in Swedish and the text 'SVENSKA LITOGRAFISKA AB. STOCKHOLM.'
